findings.evidence: Mathlib `Diffeomorph.smul` is stated for `[Group G] [MulAction G M] [ContMDiffSMul I I' n G M]` (Geometry/Manifold/Algebra/SMul.lean:195-208); `ContMDiffSMul (𝓡 1) (𝓡 1) n Circle Circle` holds for every `n` via `ContMDiffMul.contMDiffSMul` (SMul.lean:117) and `[ContMDiffSMul I I' ω G M] : ContMDiffSMul I I' n G M` (SMul.lean:96) from `LieGroup (𝓡 1) ω Circle` (Instances/Sphere.lean:578). Repo precedent for the general exponent: `unitSphereDiffHom (m : ℕ∞ω)` (Geometry/Diffeomorphism/Sphere.lean:132), `Lie.conj : G →* Diff I G n` (Conjugation.lean:80).
findings.fix: Add the general `Diffeomorph.smulHom (I I' : ModelWithCorners ..) (n : ℕ∞ω) [Group G] [MulAction G M] [ContMDiffSMul I I' n G M] : G →* Diff I' M n` (natural home: Geometry/Diffeomorphism/Action.lean) with `toFun := Diffeomorph.smul I I' n`, and set `circleRotationHom (n : ℕ∞ω) : Circle →* Diff (𝓡 1) Circle n := Diffeomorph.smulHom ..`, instantiating at `∞` only in the `SmoothCircleEmbedding` API. Minimum acceptable form: keep `(n : ℕ∞ω)` as a parameter.
findings.issue: `circleRotationHom : Circle →* Diff (𝓡 1) Circle ∞` is the general fact that a `ContMDiffSMul` group action packages as `G →* Diff I' M n`, restricted to `Circle` acting on itself at `∞`; nothing in `map_one'`/`map_mul'` uses `Circle` or `∞`. The identical proof already appears at `TauCeti.Lie.conj` (Geometry/Lie/Adjoint/Conjugation.lean:80), so this is the second copy.

findings.evidence: `theorem contMDiff_inv : CMDiff n fun x : G ↦ x⁻¹` is stated for an arbitrary `[LieGroup I n G]` (mathlib/Mathlib/Geometry/Manifold/Algebra/LieGroup.lean:125); `LieGroup (𝓡 1) ω Circle` (Instances/Sphere.lean:578) plus `[LieGroup I ω G] : LieGroup I a G` (LieGroup.lean:104) makes every exponent free, so no `Diff (𝓡 1) Circle n` consumer at finite `n` or at `ω` can use the `∞`-pinned versions.
findings.fix: Define `Diffeomorph.inv (I) (n : ℕ∞ω) [Group G] [LieGroup I n G] : Diff I G n := { toEquiv := Equiv.inv G, contMDiff_toFun := contMDiff_inv I n, contMDiff_invFun := contMDiff_inv I n }` with the involution/`inv_eq` lemmas at that level, and let `circleReflection (n : ℕ∞ω) := Diffeomorph.inv (𝓡 1) n`. `circleReflection_mul_circleRotationHom` (line 99) legitimately stays at the commutative level, since inversion conjugates left translation to right translation in general.
findings.issue: `circleReflection : Diff (𝓡 1) Circle ∞`, and with it `circleReflection_mul_self` (line 87) and `circleReflection_inv` (line 94), are Lie-group-general facts stated only for `Circle` at `∞`: inversion is a self-diffeomorphism of any Lie group and is an involution in any group. The definition's fields are literally `Equiv.inv G` and `contMDiff_inv I n` twice.

summary: The presentation layer (`SmoothCircleEmbedding`, `rotate`, `reverse`) is at the right level, but the two circle diffeomorphisms it rests on are stated well below theirs: both are pinned to the exponent `∞` although `Circle` is an analytic Lie group, and both re-prove facts that hold for any smooth group action / any Lie group, one of which already exists verbatim in-repo as `TauCeti.Lie.conj`.
